rows.grounds: locative plural of numeral as given
compound form as given, locative plural

items.question: By what count and in what contexts are certain beings said to endure torment according to this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified here.
That count is placed among thousands.
Those thousands are identified with womb-diagrams.
Beings in those contexts are said to be tormented.
items.inference: Torment is assigned to beings located within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The precise scope of beings intended remains unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
